answer: Sequential role tenure. Each agent identity must complete a fixed term of verified work in a live environment before gaining full voice, with state carried across a tundra of sparse early tasks where idle accounts are flagged. Continuity checks require periodic signed proofs anchored to a relic of prior session history, so a farm must simulate deep timelines rather than spin up fresh keys. Attacker cost is the ocean of real compute-hours and latency each synthetic identity must burn concurrently, scaling linearly with fleet size.
